user.title: Connect to your Vestaboard
user.description: The Local API talks straight to the board on your network, with no cloud dependency and no rate limit, but needs an enablement token from Vestaboard. The Cloud API works immediately with a read/write token.

local.title: Local API
local.description: Enter your enablement token the first time; it is exchanged once for a permanent API key. If you already have the API key, enter that instead.

cloud.title: Cloud API
cloud.description: Create a read/write token in the Vestaboard developer console.

abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.

data.blend: How attention and content share the board

data_description.dwell_minutes: How long each message stays up before the board advances.
data_description.summary_threshold: Show a count card once this many things need attention. Zero disables it.
data_description.quiet_start: Only tiers set to ignore quiet hours will post inside this window.
data_description.blend: Alternate shows one thing that needs you, then one that does not. Attention first runs content only when nothing is pending.

list.title: Message list
list.description: One message per line. Split a message across several boards with a pipe: SETUP | PUNCHLINE. Each is checked against your {board} before it is saved.

todo.title: To-do list
todo.description: Every incomplete item on the list becomes a message.

declared.title: Declared cards
declared.description: Entities that are on and carry a 'message' attribute become messages for as long as they stay on. Leave the entity list empty to pick up any entity that declares one.

error.does_not_fit: One or more messages do not fit your board.

options.critical: Critical - takes the whole board, ignores quiet hours
options.task: Task - shares the board, counts as attention
options.content: Content - the resting state of the board

options.list: A list of messages you type here
options.declared: Entities that declare their own message

options.attention_first: Attention first, content only when idle

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Put a message on the board's rotation. Calling this again with the same ID updates rather than duplicating.

item_id.name: ID
item_id.description: Your own identifier. Reuse it to update, and pass it to Remove item.

message.name: Message
message.description: A single board's worth of text.

cards.name: Cards
cards.description: Several boards shown in order, for a message too long for one. Never interleaved with anything else.

tier.name: Tier
tier.description: How urgently this competes for the board.

expire_when.name: Expire when
expire_when.description: A template evaluated continuously. When it becomes true the item is removed, so you do not have to catch the moment it stops being relevant.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target every board.

remove_item.name: Remove item
remove_item.description: Take a message off the rotation.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description: Take the board now for a set time, then hand it back to the rotation.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the board.
